records.deidentified_narrative: on [date] at approximately 1722 hours, i, officer h. stephens #455 and officer t. simmons #460 [roadway] [roadway], denton county, tx 76227 referencing a traffic accident involving a pedestrian. upon arrival, i observed a 2011 white convertible-style bmw 328i bearing texas license plate [identifier]. the bmw was positioned to the left of a group of people, with amir ryals (b/m [date]) sitting in the roadway. i noticed a cut on the back right side of amir's head. i asked amir if he could move his fingers and toes; he demonstrated that he could. amir's twin brother, amaris ryals (b/m [date]), stated that amir's feet left the ground after being struck by the bmw, and he landed on his back. i did not observe any scratches on amir's back. i identified amir's grandmother as cornelia latrice allen (b/f [date]). she stated that she was at her residence when the bmw struck amir and came out after amaris had notified her that amir had been hit. amir and amaris informed me that amir was riding his electronic scooter in the king george alleyway and forgot to check both [roadway]. amir repeatedly stated that he just wanted to [medical facility]. when aubrey [identifier] unit arrived on scene, they analyzed amir and determined that [medical facility] in prosper, tx., for further evaluation. once officer t. simmons arrived on scene, she identified the bmw driver and passenger. the driver was identified as wayne anthony pecoraro (w/m [date]), and the passenger was identified as tina rester pecoraro (w/f [date]). officer t. simmons observed a slight odor of alcohol emanating from wayne. i asked wayne if he had anything to drink today. he stated that he had one drink at approximately 11 a. m. i then performed standard field sobriety tests (sfsts) on wayne to determine if he was intoxicated at the time of the accident. based on the totality of circumstances and the completion of sfsts, it was determined that wayne was not intoxicated to the level that impaired his driving abilities. i confirmed with wayne that the damage to the front bumper of his vehicle was there before the accident and that no additional damage had been done. i advised tina and wayne to reach out to their insurance company if they had any questions regarding the accident. i released wayne and tina from the scene and provided them with report number 25-00210. this call for service was recorded using my watchguard bodycam and patrol unit #2403 in-car camera, labeled [identifier]. i have nothing further to report; please see officer t. simmons #460's report for further information.
